# s4communication Provider

The S4 Communication provider manages SAP S/4HANA Cloud communication systems (with their inbound and outbound users), communication users and communication arrangements.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    s4communication = {
      source = "sap-community/s4communication"
    }
  }
}

# Basic authentication with a communication user. The settings can also be
# given with the S4_HOST, S4_USERNAME and S4_PASSWORD environment variables.
provider "s4communication" {
  host     = "my000000-api.s4hana.cloud.sap"
  username = var.s4_username
  password = var.s4_password
}

# Alternatively, authenticate with the communication user's X.509 client
# certificate (mutual TLS). S4_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE and S4_CLIENT_KEY accept the
# PEM content or a file path.
#
# provider "s4communication" {
#   host               = "my000000-api.s4hana.cloud.sap"
#   client_certificate = file("communication-user.crt")
#   client_key         = file("communication-user.key")
# }

variable "s4_username" {
  type = string
}

variable "s4_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `client_certificate` (String) PEM encoded X.509 client certificate of the communication user, for authentication with mutual TLS. Intermediate certificates may follow it. Use `file("cert.pem")` to read it from a file. Can also be set with the `S4_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE` environment variable, as PEM or as a file path.
- `client_key` (String, Sensitive) PEM encoded, unencrypted private key of `client_certificate`. Can also be set with the `S4_CLIENT_KEY` environment variable, as PEM or as a file path.
- `host` (String) SAP S/4HANA Cloud API host, e.g. `my000000-api.s4hana.cloud.sap`. The provider connects over HTTPS on port 443. Can also be set with the `S4_HOST` environment variable.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for basic authentication. Can also be set with the `S4_PASSWORD` environment variable.
- `username` (String, Sensitive) Communication user for basic authentication. Can also be set with the `S4_USERNAME` environment variable. Configure either `username` and `password`, or `client_certificate` and `client_key`.
